name: Trap-Bar Deadlift
cues: Step into the center of the frame and line your ankles up with the handles
Sit your hips down until your hands reach the handles with your chest up
Brace and push the floor away with your whole foot
Finish tall with your hips and knees locked out together

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: At the floor the trunk is 53 deg from vertical, the hip joint is at 0.69 m and the knee at 84 deg. Conventional 508 is 70 deg and 0.79 m, so this is a credible, more upright trap-bar start; the plates rest on the floor (sleeve at 0.226 m) and the bar stays over the midfoot. Owner should look at two things: the near hand is hidden behind the plate in the hero view at the bottom, and thigh/trunk(lumbar3) reaches -70 mm under the reused FLOOR_START_TOL (72).
